title: Implement data retention and deletion controls
summary: When data stores or contractual duties need a controlled retention and disposal schedule. An approved retention schedule with tested deletion, legal-hold handling and evidence of authorized disposal.
outcomes: An approved retention schedule with tested deletion, legal-hold handling and evidence of authorized disposal.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When data stores or contractual duties need a controlled retention and disposal schedule.

parts.title: Inventory data categories and copies
parts.guidance: Map production systems, document stores, exports, logs and backups to owners and purposes. Identify third-party copies and distinguish records the company controls from data held under customer instructions.

references.title: GOV.UK data protection and your business

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Approve retention periods and exceptions
parts.guidance: Legal, privacy and business owners determine applicable duties, customer terms and defensible operational needs. Record legal holds and unresolved requirements instead of assigning a single retention period to all data.

references.title: GOV.UK data protection and your business

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Configure the approved lifecycle rules
parts.guidance: Authorized administrators implement access, expiration and deletion settings with documented exceptions. Confirm backup and vendor constraints and avoid deleting records subject to a hold or required retention.

references.title: GOV.UK data protection and your business

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the reviewed account operation described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Test deletion and restoration edge cases
parts.guidance: Verify representative data expires or is deleted as intended, including exports and supplier instructions. Check whether restored backups reintroduce deleted information and define the reconciliation process.

references.title: GOV.UK data protection and your business

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Review disposal evidence and exceptions
parts.guidance: Approve and retain the permitted disposal evidence without recreating the deleted personal data. Monitor failures, holds and changed purposes and reassess the schedule with the relevant owners.

references.title: GOV.UK data protection and your business

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting.
